newsitem.title: USA: ITT STARTS $2 BLN DEBT TENDER OFFER.
newsitem.headline: ITT STARTS $2 BLN DEBT TENDER OFFER.

text.p: ITT Corp said Monday that it has begun a previously announced cash tender offer to purchase $2 billion of its debt securities.
The offer expires September 9, unless extend.

The tender offer applies to $700 million in 6.25 percent notes due November 15, 2000; $250 million in 6.75 percent notes due November 15, 2003; $450 million in 6.75 percent notes due November 15, 2005; $450 million in 7.375 percent debentures due November 15, 2015; and $150 million in 7.75 percent debentures due November 15, 2025.
